data.title: About Brittany
bio: A born and raised Jersey Girl who loves to be of service to people and that shows in her current and past efforts.  Before obtaining her real estate license, Brittany worked in the education field and currently is an HR Manager.

Brittany has had the pleasure of growing up in Middlesex County, working in Monmouth County and currently residing in Ocean County, so she really has a feel for multiple areas of the state.  Aside from her work life, she is both a mom and a bonus mom to three beautiful girls and two dogs.

She is happily married to a veteran and enjoys spending her free time with her family.  Brittany has spent her career serving others and is thrilled to be part of such an energized, devoted, and innovative team.
